response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced full-stack/backend software craftsman with strong web, Node.js, TypeScript, and D-language expertise, but his profile does not align with this role's core requirement of deep, current C++ development for industrial automation platforms. His only substantial C++ experience is from 2014-2015 (National Instruments) and a bachelor thesis project, with no evidence of STL mastery, multi-threading, message brokers, MQTT, IEC 62443 security standards, or industrial protocols. His skills list does not even mention C++.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level engineering experience (14+ years) across diverse domains
Strong software craftsmanship practices: TDD, CI/CD, agile, mentoring, and workshop facilitation
Demonstrated ability to work across multiple languages and adapt to different tech stacks
concerns: C++ experience is minimal, outdated (2014-2015), and absent from core skills list
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No demonstrated exposure to MQTT, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, etc.), or message-broker-based large-scale systems

key_factors.factor: No MQTT/industrial protocol or IoT platform experience
